name: BC337
description: NPN complement to the BC327, common in audio driver/output stages and as a higher-current (800mA) small-signal switch. Like the rest of the European BC family, the TO-92 pinout is C-B-E (flat face toward you, leads down, left to right), the reverse of American parts like the 2N3904.

pins.name: C
pins.description: collector (leftmost lead, flat face toward you)

TO-92.notes: flat face toward you, leads down: C-B-E left to right. Datasheets disagree on lead NUMBERING (onsemi numbers the left lead pin 1 = C; multicomp numbers the right lead pin 1 = E) but the physical layout is the same C-B-E.

typical_application: Audio driver and small output stages (paired with BC327), general switching up to 800mA, LED and small relay drivers. Add a flyback diode for inductive loads.
gotchas: pinout is C-B-E (European family), the REVERSE of the 2N3904 (E-B-C); do not assume
datasheets number the leads inconsistently (onsemi pin 1 = collector on the left; multicomp pin 1 = emitter on the right) even though the physical C-B-E layout is identical; when in doubt, meter it
800mA absolute max collector current; derate hard for continuous use
hFE depends on the -25 or -40 suffix; do not design for an exact gain
